subject: Taxes
title: What Is DeFi?
description: A micro-lesson that makes What Is DeFi? usable.

hook.text: Decentralized Finance removes banks from lending. You deposit crypto into a smart contract and earn interest.

buildup.text: DeFi protocols like Aave and Compound let users lend, borrow, and trade without intermediaries.

discovery.text: DeFi has no central entity issuing tax forms. No 1099s, no W-2s.

twist.text: A single DeFi strategy might trigger dozens of tax events: deposits, rewards, swaps, withdrawals.

climax.text: DeFi created a financial system faster than tax law could follow. The gap between innovation and regulation grows daily.

punchline.text: No bank, no tax form. DeFi leaves billions in transactions unreported.

quiz.question: Why is DeFi difficult to tax?
options: No central entity issues tax forms, so users must self-track
